iut_type: End Product (OM Digital Solutions HFP headset device), pre-test equipment and document checklist
customer_question: Before starting HFP profile testing, what equipment (DUT) do we need to provide, and what other items/documents should we prepare and send?
question_variants: What hardware do we need to ship for HFP testing?
What documentation is needed alongside the test sample?
actual_issue: The customer needed a concrete checklist of what physical equipment and supporting documentation to prepare and ship before HFP profile testing could begin, since this was the start of a new engagement and the requirements weren't yet clear.
plain_english_explanation: For HFP testing, the customer needs to provide one unit functionally equivalent to the actual product (no modification needed) plus an AC adapter, along with any available HFP operation manual or usage notes. Separately, four supporting items need to be submitted: (1) an ICS document defining the product's supported HFP functionality (using SIG's standard ICS form template), (2) an Invoice obtained following Allion's wire-transfer-proxy procedure document, (3) a completed Questionnaire used for HFP report documentation purposes, and (4) a completed proxy registration confirmation document, to be submitted by the time HFP testing completes.
consultant_answer: For HFP testing, please provide one unit functionally equivalent to your actual product (no modification needed) plus an AC adapter, along with any HFP operation manual or usage notes you have available. Please also send: (1) an ICS document defining your product's supported HFP functionality, using the standard ICS form template; (2) an Invoice obtained via our attached wire-transfer-proxy procedure; (3) a completed Questionnaire for HFP report documentation; and (4) a completed proxy registration confirmation document, by the time HFP testing completes.
decision_logic: Pre-test equipment and document requirements for a profile test (HFP) should be communicated as a complete, itemized checklist at engagement start (hardware sample, supporting manual, ICS declaration, Invoice, Questionnaire, registration confirmation document) rather than requested piecemeal as the project progresses.
final_recommendation: At the start of a new profile-testing engagement, provide the customer with a complete itemized checklist of both physical equipment and supporting documentation needed, to avoid delays from incremental, piecemeal requests later in the project.
risk_if_done_wrong: Requesting equipment and documents piecemeal rather than as an upfront checklist could cause avoidable delays in starting HFP testing, since each missing item discovered late would require another round-trip communication.
